verdict.rationale: ReelMimic documents configurable concurrency limits: BUILDERS/MAX_AGENTS set agents per video (default 6) and a cross-project cap (default 12). It also notes that a job pauses on hitting a limit and can resume. Queue behavior for batch rendering is not described, such as what happens when projects exceed the global cap, ordering, or prioritization. Missing for 10: documented queueing semantics for jobs beyond the global limit, batch-rendering throughput guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline

citations.quote: How many agents work on one video at once (default 6), and the limit across all projects (default 12)
If you hit a limit, the job pauses and can pick up where it stopped.
Up to 6 work on different parts of the video.
